questions.question: What encouragement does God repeatedly give Israel in Isaiah 41?
options: Rejoice, for your wealth will increase
Fear not, for I am with you; I will help you
Repent, for the great day of judgment is near
Flee, for the enemy is at the gates
questions.answer: Fear not, for I am with you; I will help you

questions.question: How does Isaiah 41 challenge the idols?
options: To send down the rain upon the parched and the thirsty ground
To declare what is to come, proving they are nothing
To raise up the dead and bring them out from their graves
To lead all of the people safely through the midst of the sea
questions.answer: To declare what is to come, proving they are nothing

questions.question: God calls Israel the offspring of Abraham, his friend, whom he chose.
Fear not, for I am with you; be not dismayed, for I am your God; I will strengthen you, I will help you, I will uphold you with my righteous right _____.
I am the LORD your God, who takes hold of your right hand and says: Do not fear, I will _____ you.
